text: ロケットだんに　たてつかない　ほうが　みのため　だぜ

structure.jp: ロケットだんに　たてつかない　ほうが

patterns.name: 〜ほうがいい
patterns.span: たてつかない　ほうが
patterns.explanation: ほうが after a verb picks that choice as the better one; here 'is for your own good' stands in place of the usual いい. たてつかない　ほうが = 'not defying them is the better choice'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, tough-guy talk that pushes the statement at the listener. みのため　だぜ = 'it's for your own good, I tell ya'.
